opportunities.historical_importance: Would extend the exact spin-one arbitrary-channel result to unbounded dimension with slow spin modes while retaining one common classical channel.
strongest_prior: Werner symmetric cloner isotropic equality space
opportunities.concrete_new_mechanism: All-j equality-space perturbation forces alpha_j=(2j+1)/(4j+1); exact envelope derivative is derived, not assumed.
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma: Global all-weight positivity with alpha_j or direct legal tracial-star domination; rank4 and higher envelope curvature remains uncontrolled.
compatibility_obligations: exact CP broadcaster and equal marginals
opportunities.early_falsification: Fixed3/5 allocation already fails at exact rational weights j3/2 and single-axis j7/2; alpha_j passes the exact single-axis interval.
opportunities.likely_significance_if_established: A dimension-uniform sharp comparator on a non-Clifford three-generator Lie observable family; no full algebra claim.
